candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, resetPassword only updates the user's password. It never deletes the user's sessions, so refresh tokens on other devices stay valid and can still renew their login. By comparison, AuthService.update calls sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude when the password is changed.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, call this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }) so every session is revoked and all refresh tokens stop working.
